parameters.command:
set -u

ssh_opts="-o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=5 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new"

controller_reachable=$(ssh $ssh_opts ubuntu@hpc-controller 'echo ok' 2>/dev/null || echo fail)
compute_reachable=$(ssh $ssh_opts ubuntu@hpc-compute01 'echo ok' 2>/dev/null || echo fail)

slurmctld=$(ssh $ssh_opts ubuntu@hpc-controller 'systemctl is-active slurmctld 2>/dev/null || true' 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)
controller_munge=$(ssh $ssh_opts ubuntu@hpc-controller 'systemctl is-active munge 2>/dev/null || true' 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)

slurmd=$(ssh $ssh_opts ubuntu@hpc-compute01 'systemctl is-active slurmd 2>/dev/null || true' 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)
compute_munge=$(ssh $ssh_opts ubuntu@hpc-compute01 'systemctl is-active munge 2>/dev/null || true' 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)

slurm_controller=$(ssh $ssh_opts ubuntu@hpc-controller 'scontrol ping 2>/dev/null | grep -q "UP" && echo up || echo down' 2>/dev/null || echo down)
slurm_state=$(ssh $ssh_opts ubuntu@hpc-controller "sinfo -h -N -o '%T' 2>/dev/null | head -1" 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)

nfs_compute=$(ssh $ssh_opts ubuntu@hpc-compute01 'mountpoint -q /research && echo mounted || echo missing' 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)

disk_pct=$(ssh $ssh_opts ubuntu@hpc-controller "df -P /research 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==2 {gsub(\"%\",\"\",\$5); print \$5}'" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
[ -n "$disk_pct" ] || disk_pct=0

prom_controller=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 3 http://hpc-controller:9100/metrics || echo 000)
prom_compute=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 3 http://hpc-compute01:9100/metrics || echo 000)
prometheus=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 3 http://localhost:9090/-/healthy || echo 000)
grafana=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 3 http://localhost:3000/login || echo 000)

printf '{"controller_reachable":"%s","compute_reachable":"%s","slurmctld":"%s","controller_munge":"%s","slurmd":"%s","compute_munge":"%s","slurm_controller":"%s","slurm_state":"%s","nfs_compute":"%s","research_disk_pct":%s,"prom_controller":"%s","prom_compute":"%s","prometheus":"%s","grafana":"%s"}\n' \
"$controller_reachable" "$compute_reachable" "$slurmctld" "$controller_munge" "$slurmd" "$compute_munge" "$slurm_controller" "$slurm_state" "$nfs_compute" "$disk_pct" "$prom_controller" "$prom_compute" "$prometheus" "$grafana"

set +e
ssh_opts="-o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=5 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new"

echo "HPC_AUTOPILOT_REPAIR_START"

# Controller services
if ! ssh $ssh_opts ubuntu@hpc-controller 'systemctl is-active --quiet munge'; then
  echo "Restarting Munge on controller"
  ssh $ssh_opts ubuntu@hpc-controller 'sudo systemctl restart munge'
fi

if ! ssh $ssh_opts ubuntu@hpc-controller 'systemctl is-active --quiet slurmctld'; then
  echo "Restarting slurmctld"
  ssh $ssh_opts ubuntu@hpc-controller 'sudo systemctl restart slurmctld'
fi

# Compute services
if ! ssh $ssh_opts ubuntu@hpc-compute01 'systemctl is-active --quiet munge'; then
  echo "Restarting Munge on compute"
  ssh $ssh_opts ubuntu@hpc-compute01 'sudo systemctl restart munge'
fi

if ! ssh $ssh_opts ubuntu@hpc-compute01 'systemctl is-active --quiet slurmd'; then
  echo "Restarting slurmd"
  ssh $ssh_opts ubuntu@hpc-compute01 'sudo systemctl restart slurmd'
fi

# NFS
if ! ssh $ssh_opts ubuntu@hpc-compute01 'mountpoint -q /research'; then
  echo "Attempting NFS remount"
  ssh $ssh_opts ubuntu@hpc-compute01 'sudo mount -a'
fi

# Node Exporter
if ! curl -fsS --max-time 3 http://hpc-controller:9100/metrics >/dev/null; then
  echo "Restarting controller Node Exporter"
  ssh $ssh_opts ubuntu@hpc-controller 'sudo systemctl restart prometheus-node-exporter'
fi

if ! curl -fsS --max-time 3 http://hpc-compute01:9100/metrics >/dev/null; then
  echo "Restarting compute Node Exporter"
  ssh $ssh_opts ubuntu@hpc-compute01 'sudo systemctl restart prometheus-node-exporter'
fi

# Monitoring services on hpc-admin
if ! curl -fsS --max-time 3 http://localhost:9090/-/healthy >/dev/null; then
  echo "Restarting Prometheus"
  sudo systemctl restart prometheus
fi

if ! curl -fsS --max-time 3 http://localhost:3000/login >/dev/null; then
  echo "Restarting Grafana"
  sudo systemctl restart grafana-server
fi

# Resume node only when Slurm explicitly reports a recoverable DOWN/DRAIN state
state=$(ssh $ssh_opts ubuntu@hpc-controller "sinfo -h -N -o '%T' | head -1")
case "$state" in
  *down*|*drain*|*drng*)
    echo "Attempting to resume hpc-compute01 from state: $state"
    ssh $ssh_opts ubuntu@hpc-controller 'sudo scontrol update NodeName=hpc-compute01 State=RESUME'
    ;;
esac

sleep 7
echo "HPC_AUTOPILOT_REPAIR_END"
